name: m5_morpho
_doc: M5 gate — bed state + morphodynamics (RESEARCH §5, §7). (a-i) still-water deposition column: uniform c0 settles onto a flat bed; Sigma f_pack*h rises at w_s*c0 (bed elevation at w_s*c0/0.64) and total sand (bed+suspended) is conserved. (a-ii) prescribed sinusoidal bedload q_b(x)=q0*sin(2pi x/L) with E=D=0, checked against 1D Exner (1-p)dz_b/dt=-dq_b/dx via the upwind donor-cell divergence. (b) sand-pile relaxes to the 30-32 deg repose band via 8-neighbour avalanching (mass-conserving). (c) three-reservoir sand mass (bed f_pack + suspended c + zero boundary flux) conserved over 1e4 steps with deposition+Winterwerp erosion+bedload+avalanche all active. (d) no motion below Soulsby-Whitehouse theta_cr (clear water, c=0 so deposition cannot move the bed); onset within 10%. All physics constants config-derived per RESEARCH §5/§7.
